items.summary: qbee-agent contains a Zip Slip vulnerability in its tar extraction logic used for Docker Compose build contexts. The vulnerability arises because the path validation uses a prefix check that does not enforce path separator boundaries, allowing crafted archive entries to write files outside the intended extraction directory. items.title: Silverstripe Framework: RCE via i18nTextCollectorTask writer parameter (CVE-2026-91115)
items.summary: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Silverstripe Framework versions 6.0.0 up to but not including 6.2.13. The issue arises from the i18nTextCollectorTask dev task's writer parameter being passed to the injector without validation, allowing crafted URLs to create arbitrary objects and execute code on the server. This can be triggered without login

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: User-controlled ClassName allows unauthorized record type change (CVE-2026-91113)
items.summary: A vulnerability in Silverstripe Framework versions prior to 6.2.13 allows a user with permission to edit a record via a GridField detail form to change the record's class to an unrelated type without proper permission checks. This can lead to unauthorized modification of record types. (CVSS: 4.3)

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: CMS_ACCESS_SecurityAdmin privilege escalation (CVE-2026-91112)
items.summary: A privilege escalation vulnerability exists in Silverstripe Framework versions prior to 6.2.13. A user with access to the Security section but without ADMIN permission can edit a group that grants ADMIN privileges via roles or parent groups, allowing them to escalate their own privileges. (CVSS: 6.8)

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: Auth bypass GridFieldDetailForm (CVE-2026-88989)
items.summary: A vulnerability in Silverstripe Framework versions prior to 6.2.13 allows a CMS user with permission to edit records via a GridField detail form to bypass creation permissions. By sending a crafted save request directly, the user can create new records without having explicit create permissions. This issue has been fixed in version 6.2.13. (CVSS: 4.3)

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via SVG data URI (CVE-2026-88988)
items.summary: A cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Silverstripe Framework versions prior to 6.2.13 due to the HTML sanitizer not removing SVG data URIs. This allows a CMS author to store content that executes JavaScript in the browsers of other users who view the content. The issue is fixed in version 6.2.13. (CVSS: 5.4)

items.title: Silverstripe Framework: XSS via XHTML data URI (CVE-2026-88987)
items.summary: Silverstripe Framework versions prior to 6.2.13 contain a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability due to the HTML sanitiser failing to remove XHTML and XML data URIs. This allows a CMS author to store content that executes JavaScript in the browsers of other users who view the content. The vulnerability has a medium severity with a CVSS score of 5.4 and was

items.title: Directus: Share update allows reassigning user_created and role (CVE-2026-129239)
items.summary: A vulnerability in Directus versions prior to 12.3.1 allows a non-admin user with update permission on their own shares to reassign critical share attributes such as the creator and role.
